items.prompt: What does a coupon-bond yield to maturity represent?

options.text: A universal default-free rate for all currencies
options.why: It is tied to that price/schedule/convention.

options.text: The probability the issuer will pay
options.why: It is a yield,not that probability.

options.text: A proof that every promised flow is certain
One rate reproducing that bond's promised-flow price
options.why: A term structure can instead use separate maturity factors.

items.explanation: Do not confuse one bond YTM with the full spot curve.
